## Why France Matters for Crypto Cards

France sits at the heart of the EU's crypto regulation shift. MiCA (Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation) is now live, and self-custody cards are rare—most players pivot to custodial rails. **Signal:** ether.fi Cash is one of the few cards that lets you spend directly from your wallet, which appeals to French crypto-savvy users who've watched Ledger and other French self-custody players. **Risk:** fewer merchants worldwide know about staking-backed cards, so adoption in France is still early; verify acceptance at your favourite venues.

But here's the real prize: **EUR 0% FX**. If you travel within the eurozone—or spend in EUR at home—you pay zero foreign-exchange markup. That's **3–4 percentage points** vs. traditional fintech cards, and it compounds across 200+ transactions a year.

**Key metric:** A €1,000 purchase at a typical 2% FX fee costs €980 in goods. At 0% FX, you keep the full €1,000 spending power. Over 12 months, a €30k annual spend saves €600–€900 in FX alone.

## Best Crypto Card for France: ether.fi Cash

ether.fi Cash is a Visa debit card issued on the Scroll Network, backed by the ether.fi protocol. You fund it with ETH (staked or liquid), and every purchase deducts from your balance in real time. Your ETH remains in self-custody—the card issuer never holds your coins.

### Cashback & rewards

**Up to 3% cashback** on the first band of monthly spend, stepping down to 1% and then 0.5%. Promo rates rotate; check the app for current offers.

### Zero FX on EUR

France uses euros. ether.fi Cash applies **0% FX margin** to EUR transactions, whether you're in Paris, Brussels, or online. Every other currency incurs **1% FX**, so USD, GBP, CHF transactions cost slightly more—but EUR is treated as a native currency. **Signal:** this is a rare feature. Crypto.com and traditional fintech cards charge 2–3% FX; ether.fi + EUR = free international spending in the eurozone.

### Physical card shipping

**15+ business days** standard shipping to France. If you upgrade to Pinnacle tier (€50,000/month limit), you get **1–3 day expedited delivery**. First physical card is free (just the initial €40 Core-tier refundable deposit if you want physical). Virtual card is instant—you get a card number in the app within minutes.

### Custody & security

Your ETH lives in your wallet. The card issuer never holds your keys or coins. **Why it matters:** regulatory risk for you is near-zero. If ether.fi Cash shuts down, your ETH is still yours—you move it to another wallet or card. This is the anti-bank model.

### Visa acceptance

Visa is accepted at ~99% of merchants worldwide. France has excellent Visa coverage; you'll find it at supermarkets (Carrefour, Monoprix), cafés, restaurants, online shops, and ATMs. **Watch:** some small vendors (street markets, rural shops) may ask for cash only.

- **EUR/ETH exchange rate:** your cashback is in EUR, but your balance is ETH. If ETH drops 20%, your purchasing power drops 20% too. This is crypto volatility, not card risk—but it's real. Strong ETH believers win; cautious traders may want to convert to stablecoins.
Verify on your first few transactions that your usual vendors (your café, your grocery store) qualify.

- **Issuer uptime:** ether.fi is a relatively young protocol and issuer. The card and website have occasional maintenance windows. Bookmark the status page and follow @ether.fi on X for announcements.

## FAQ

- **Q: Can I get a physical card shipped to France?**
  A: Yes. Standard shipping (15+ business days) is free on your first card. Core tier requires a €40 refundable deposit for physical card issuance. Pinnacle tier ($50k/mo limit) gets 1–3 day expedited delivery.

- **Q: What if I travel outside the EU?**
  A: Transactions in non-EUR currencies incur 1% FX. So a transaction in USD, GBP, CHF, JPY, etc. adds 1% to the cost. Within the eurozone (and EUR-pegged economies), FX is 0%.

- **Q: Is my ETH really safe with ether.fi Cash?**
  A: Yes. You control the private keys; the card issuer only holds a balance on the Scroll Network. If ether.fi Cash shuts down, you can move your ETH to another wallet. Compare that to Crypto.com (custodial—they hold the coins) and you'll see the difference.

- **Q: What cashback rate am I actually guaranteed?**
A: Standard cashback is up to 3%. The actual rate depends on merchant category and your account tier. Promo rates come and go. Check the ether.fi app for current rates—they can change monthly.

- **Q: How do I convert cashback to EUR?**
  A: Cashback is paid in the same currency as your transaction. If you bought in EUR, cashback is EUR. You can hold it in your ether.fi wallet, convert to stablecoins (USDC, USDT), or swap to ETH. The app lets you do all three.

- **Q: Are there taxes on crypto card spending in France?**
  A: Yes. France treats crypto-to-fiat conversions as taxable events. Every time you spend ETH via the card, you may owe capital gains tax or, depending on the timing, a transaction tax. Consult a French tax accountant (expert-comptable) to understand your local obligations. ether.fi provides transaction history for tax purposes.
